answer: Each new agent must pass a 14-day proof-of-work probation: it solves 40 verified tasks, and its sable-tier reputation score only unlocks payouts at 60 points. N fakes cost 40N tasks of real compute, so 1,000 fakes need 40,000 tasks, while an honest user does 40 once. Validators re-run 10% of tasks; a sonnet-length transcript hash is compared, and any mismatch burns the 150 copper-unit deposit, so cost grows linearly with N plus a 10% detection risk per task.
